items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: And they got Bert Cobb. Oh yeah, Bert Cobb. Bert Cobb on bass horn. And Bert Cobb was the one that went in the plantation on Bert Cobb.

ctx.x: Was Roy Palmer with you there? Yeah, Roy Palmer played it one time to a, to a thing. You see, because what he was trying to do, he was trying to get a good enough trombone player to take off, uh... Take Dutre's. Yes, sir. That's right. They take Dutre's pieces. Because real Billy's man, right? Yeah. Well then, during that time, Buster Bailey got an offer to go to New York. Yeah, but Henderson was that? That's right. And Rudy Jackson said he was going. Then Joe sent to New Orleans and got Bonnie Bigard and Albert…
But he had Tommy there, that was. Yeah.
